notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Life Insurance and Zulaport Cutthroat triggers.
Resolve the Life Insurance trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each player to lose 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Activate Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat.
